children: will stop selling insurance as an agent after a fire insurance fraud involving its employees came to light,
reported on November 14. The company said it has told three of Japan's biggest nonlife insurers of the decision.

The exit ends a side business in which Tama Home sold fire and life insurance products to customers buying its houses. The three insurers, Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance, Sompo Japan Insurance and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance, have already begun taking steps to halt sales of their products through the homebuilder.
Tama Home said it is considering bringing in outside experts to examine the fraud so that the investigation remains objective.

The misconduct took place at the company's branch in Takamatsu, the capital of Kagawa Prefecture in western Japan. Among the irregularities, staff there submitted the same photographs as proof of damage in more than one fire insurance claim in practices that began more than five years ago.

title: Japan's Tama Home to exit insurance agency after fraud
